description: This file defines an abstract class 'PdfDictionaryWithContentStream' in the PdfSharp library, which provides functionality for handling PDF dictionaries with content streams, including resource management for fonts, images, and forms.

classes.name: PdfDictionaryWithContentStream
classes.description: An abstract base class for PDF dictionaries that have an associated content stream, managing resources like fonts, images, and forms.

classes.name: PdfDictionaryWithContentStream.Keys
classes.description: Contains the key definitions for entries in the PDF dictionary, such as Resources.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a font resource based on a glyph typeface and font type, registers it in resources, and returns its name.

methods.name: GetFontName
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a font resource based on an identifier and font data, registers it, and returns its name.

methods.name: GetImageName
methods.description: Obtains the resource name for an image, adding it to resources if needed.

methods.name: GetFormName
methods.description: Gets the resource name of a form XObject, adding it to resources if necessary.
